gloss: to be proud, to hold one's head high

definitions.gloss: to be proud, to hold one's head high with confidence
definitions.explanation: To feel and display pride or confidence, often shown through upright posture.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{仕事|しごと}に{胸|むね}を{張|は}れる。
examples.english: I can be proud of my work.

examples.japanese: {胸|むね}を{張|は}って{生|い}きていきたい。
examples.english: I want to live with my head held high.

examples.japanese: {堂々|どうどう}と{胸|むね}を{張|は}って{歩|ある}いた。
examples.english: She walked confidently with her chest out.

examples.japanese: {胸|むね}を{張|は}って{言|い}えることだ。
examples.english: It's something I can say proudly.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちの{前|まえ}で{胸|むね}を{張|は}れる{大人|おとな}でいたい。ごまかしのない{生|い}き{方|かた}をしたいと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I want to be an adult who can hold my head high in front of children. I want to live honestly.

notes:
STRUCTURE: {胸|むね} (chest) + を + {張|は}る (to stretch out). Literally 'to stretch out one's chest' - the posture of pride.

NUANCE: Implies legitimate pride based on achievement or integrity, not arrogance. Often used to express:
- Pride in one's work or accomplishments
- Living without shame
- Confidence in one's choices

POTENTIAL FORM: {胸|むね}を{張|は}れる (can be proud) is very common
- {胸|むね}を{張|は}って{言|い}える: can say proudly/confidently

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {誇|ほこ}りに{思|おも}う (to feel proud)
- {自信|じしん}を{持|も}つ (to have confidence)
- {堂々|どうどう}と (dignified, confidently)

OTHER {胸|むね} EXPRESSIONS:
- {胸|むね}が{痛|いた}む (to feel heartache)
- {胸|むね}を{打|う}つ (to be moving, touching)
- {胸|むね}が{一杯|いっぱい} (heart is full)
